sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: The second pup crouches against a mossy root, feathers dark along its back, eyes wide, body folded small enough to hope the forest keeps it.

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: A crouched strixwolf pup with darker back feathers, round eyes, and a body tucked near the roots as if the forest itself might hide it.

sections.title: GM truth
sections.body: No forced reveal. Let this entity disclose truth through scene context and player attention.

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use to invite gentle action: distance, food, lowered weapons, and player descriptions of care.
